name: Dialog
summary: Modal surface that interrupts for a focused task.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled, always. The dialog never closes itself; it asks, through onClose, and you decide. Two sources for one piece of state is how a dialog gets stuck open.

props.name: title
props.description: Rendered as the <h2> in the header and used as the accessible name. Required: a modal with no name announces only "dialog".

props.name: children
props.description: The body. It is the part that scrolls; the header and footer stay put.

props.name: footer
props.description: The actions row. Leave it out and the footer is not rendered at all, rather than rendered empty.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called by Escape, by the backdrop, and by the close button — one exit for the three, so a dialog cannot be dismissable one way and not another.

props.name: size
props.description: The width: the reference library's four — xs 320, sm 384, md 448 (the default) and lg 512 —, xl (1024, the --breakpoint-lg token) for a wide detail view, and full: the screen minus the usual margin, keeping the 22 radius.

props.name: dismissible
props.description: false keeps the dialog open during an operation: no Escape, no click outside, and the close button is DISABLED rather than hidden, so the header does not move mid-operation.

props.name: icon
props.description: An icon in a 40 circle above the title, as in the reference library. Decorative: the title says what the dialog is.

props.name: iconTone
props.description: The circle's colour: the state colours (the *-bg fill and the -400 glyph, ADR-0061), or brand — the light yellow wash with the yellow-as-text glyph.

props.name: placement
props.description: Where the dialog sits. auto, the reference library's default: at the BOTTOM on a phone (below 640, where the thumb reaches) and in the middle from 640 up.
